name: WP Settings:WordPress Settings and Database Backup
author: CodeCompiled

sections.description:
Simplify WordPress site management with this powerful Settings Plugin.You can use it for displaying important WordPress environment details such as the general WordPress settings,PHP settings(such as version),Server and MySql details.You can generate Database Backup Script which could be used for restoring database and site migration.There are many settings which should be configured properly and WP Settings plugin will help you see all the useful settings from a single location.You can access WordPress settings,PHP related settings,DB details and installed plugins.

Features

  • View WordPress settings such as version and url.

  • MySQL details such as version and database.

  • Generate clean, SQL-compatible database backup scripts for safekeeping or migration.

  • View Server details such as Apache version.

  • View PHP settings.

  • View installed Plugins.

  • Easily manage and export your WordPress settings.
sections.installation:
1. Download via Plugins – Add New.You can also download wp-settings.zip and upload it to the /wp-content/plugins directory
  2. Activate the WP Settings plugin.
  3. View different details related to Themes,Php,MySQL in menu WP Settings
  4. Generate script for creating database backup
